name: Open-Meteo Weather
description: Current weather conditions and forecasts from Open-Meteo

open-meteo.purpose: Current weather, hourly (up to 7 days), and daily (up to 16 days) forecasts. Global coverage.
open-meteo.dataSent: Coordinates (latitude, longitude), requested weather variables, unit preferences
open-meteo.dataReceived: Current: temperature, humidity, weather code, cloud cover, pressure, wind. Hourly/daily: same per interval plus sunrise/sunset.
